name: Model Router
description: Intelligent per-prompt model routing based on query complexity. Routes each prompt to the most efficient model that meets your accuracy threshold.

sidecarUrl.description: URL of the model-router sidecar (model-router serve-router)

tolerance.description: Accuracy–efficiency tradeoff. Higher = more efficiency, lower = more accuracy.

enabled.description: Enable/disable routing. When disabled, OpenClaw uses its default model selection.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout for sidecar requests in milliseconds.

pool.description: Maps router model names to OpenClaw provider/model refs.
